name: Cohen Woodworking
about:
Cohen Woodworking was founded in 1982 in St. James, Missouri. The company is owned by two brothers and was founded by their father, operating as an architectural woodworking firm with a focus on long-term client relationships.

The firm standardizes production processes to deliver custom millwork components and casework, ensuring high-quality architectural woodwork for new construction, renovation, and disaster reconstruction projects nationwide.

Cohen serves clients in healthcare, education, retail, transportation, and hospitality sectors, working with companies and contractors across all 50 states and maintaining a national on-time delivery standard.

The company emphasizes a direct-to-vendor partnership model, collaborating from project start to finish, and has maintained AWI Quality Certification since 2008, along with four AWI Awards of Excellence and recognition on the INC 5000 list of fastest-growing companies. Its reputation rests on precision quality, consistent results, and high integrity.

name: Coil Tec of Arizona Inc
old_description: Committed to producing the highest Quality magnetic components since 1989.
about:
Coil Tec of Arizona Inc. has manufactured magnetic components from Phoenix, Arizona since 1989. The privately held company operates a 35,000-square-foot production facility where it builds transformers, inductors, and coils for a range of electronic applications.

Production is organized around cellular manufacturing, a method the company says yields the most predictable outcomes. Every part receives 100% testing within its cell, and the quality team samples all output under a zero-defect plan. A standing inventory of finished goods supports on-time shipment.

The company does not specify target industries in its public materials; its components are suited for any application requiring magnetic coils, transformers, or inductors.

Coil Tec positions itself on three pillars: quality assurance through cellular manufacturing and 100% in-cell testing with zero-defect sampling; delivery reliability via maintained finished-goods inventory; and cost advantage driven by low overhead and the efficiency of cellular production.

name: Coldstream Power
old_description: Coldstream Power helps clients reduce their energy costs & carbon footprints.
about:
Coldstream Power is based in Milford, Ohio, and was founded in 2006 by Jon Davis as the solar energy branch of the Coldstream Companies. The locally owned small business began with a goal of helping homeowners in the greater Cincinnati area take control of their energy futures and find cost savings on utility bills while increasing sustainability.

The company designs and installs custom solar panel systems for both rooftop and ground-mount applications, using equipment such as REC and Meyer Burger panels with Enphase microinverters and batteries. It also installs Generac whole-home and partial-home generators, EV chargers compatible with any vehicle, and upgrades aging electrical service panels. Coldstream Power performs all work with an in-house design team and does not use subcontractors; most solar installations are completed within one to two days.

Coldstream Power serves residential and commercial customers across the greater Cincinnati region, including Milford, Mason, West Chester, Blue Ash, Loveland, Montgomery, and numerous surrounding communities. Project examples include a 5.6 kW system in Miamisburg, a 10 kW system with battery storage in Milford, a 53-panel array in Morrow, and a Meyer Burger installation in Montgomery.

The company emphasizes its local ownership, over two decades of experience, a policy of never using subcontractors, product selection, and an in-house design team as key differentiators. It also offers free consultations, transparent pricing with savings modeling, and flexible financing options including $0-down installations.

name: Cole Wire & Cable Co
old_description: A trusted distributor of high-quality wire and cable products since 1979, Cole Wire is a family-owned and operated company, built on our reputation for personalized service, fast turnaround, and a deep understanding of what keeps your projects moving.
about:
Cole Wire & Cable Co., Inc. was founded in 1979 by Shel and Teri Cole in Lincolnshire, Illinois. The family-owned business has grown into one of the nation's largest master stocking distributors of specialty electrical and electronic wire and cable. Now led by second-generation owner Leo Cole, the company operates from a 26,000-square-foot combined office and warehouse in Lincolnshire, with additional sales offices in Ohio, and serves customers across the U.S. and internationally in Canada, Mexico, the United Kingdom, and China.

The company maintains a multi-million-dollar inventory of wire and cable products, including portable cord, tray cable, hook-up wire, armored cable, power cable, low-voltage wire, and electronic wire and cable. Beyond distribution, Cole Wire provides a full suite of in-house value-added services: custom dyeing, striping, printing, twisting, bundling, kitting, cut-to-length, stripping, crimping, harness building, re-spooling, and design/build/stocking programs. Its custom manufacturing capabilities cover wire harnesses, cord sets, coil cords, and tailored assemblies for OEM, automotive, aerospace, and industrial applications, scalable from prototype to thousands of units.

Cole Wire serves OEMs and manufacturers with precise wire configurations bundled and stripped for production-line efficiency; construction and electrical contractors with custom-cut, labeled, and job-ready cable; marine and offshore clients with rugged, corrosion-resistant cable; and specialty contractors needing pump cables, high-temperature wire, and heavy-duty custom solutions. The company also supports automotive, aerospace, and general industrial sectors.

The company's stated mission is to provide solutions that earn greater efficiencies for customers. It differentiates itself through same-day shipping on stocked items, no cut charges, in-house control over all custom services, ISO 9001-certified quality processes, and a focus on personalized service, fast competitive quotes, and responsive communication.

name: Colorado Contract Cut & Sew
old_description: We die-cut for all types of fabric and foam as well as bias and straight cutting and binding.
about:
Colorado Contract Cut & Sew operates from Denver, Colorado, where it was founded in 1989 as a family-owned and operated business. The company began with a focus on die-cutting services for fabric and foam and has since expanded into a full production facility.

The shop provides die-cutting for all types of fabric and foam, bias and straight cutting, binding, and a range of sewing operations including coverstitch (three-needle), heat-seal pressing for labels, and automatic snap attachment. Equipment includes an automatic servo cutting table with spreader, automatic precision knife cutting systems, and modular die presses. The facility handles pattern making, product design, prototyping, sample runs, and quick-turn short-run manufacturing, though it does not specialize in early-stage prototyping.

The company serves diverse corporate markets, working with brands that need production-ready soft goods without large minimum orders. Customers include businesses requiring label changes, clip tabs, and consistent fabric cutting for applications such as apparel, accessories, and industrial textiles.

Colorado Contract Cut & Sew emphasizes a collaborative process between its team and the customer, built on a reputation for reliability, quality, and service developed over more than 35 years. The ownership cites serious responsibility, creativity, and determination as core values that differentiate the operation.

name: Colorado Electric Corp
old_description: Providing Denver EV Charger Installations, Panel Upgrades, Service Calls, and New Home Wiring for Residential Clients
about:
Colorado Electric Corp is an electrical contracting firm headquartered in Lakewood, Colorado, serving the Greater Denver metro area. The company was founded in 2006 by Dan, who brought two decades of hands-on electrical experience to establish a business built on clear communication and craftsmanship.

The firm specializes in high-impact electrical upgrades for residential, multi-family, and commercial properties. Core services include main panel upgrades, Level 2 EV charger installations, SPAN smart panel systems, full building electrification, rewiring, and new construction wiring. With over 20 years of experience in West Denver and Jefferson County, the team handles projects ranging from dedicated equipment circuits to custom remodels and complete build-outs.

Customers include homeowners preparing for electrification, multi-dwelling unit developers, commercial property owners, and local trade partners such as plumbing and HVAC companies that rely on Colorado Electric Corp for code-compliant electrical connections. The company also assists clients in identifying utility rebates, including Xcel Energy programs, and federal tax incentives for qualifying upgrades.

Differentiators emphasized by the company include a no-upselling approach, a three-year workmanship warranty, and a policy that every technician sent to a job site holds an individual license and insurance. As a SPAN Certified Installer, the firm provides transparent, upfront estimates—often via phone or photo review—and focuses on delivering practical, code-compliant solutions tailored to each project's scope.

name: Colorado Industrial Packaging
old_description: We take pride in working to understand our customers specific needs, and designing and delivering solutions that meet packaging, cost, and time requirements. Colorado Industrial Packaging specializes in high-quality box packaging design in Denver, Aurora and Colorado Springs, CO, creating functional and visually appealing solutions tailored to your needs.
about:
Colorado Industrial Packaging operates from Aurora, Colorado, serving the Front Range communities of Denver, Colorado Springs, and surrounding areas. The company provides custom packaging solutions and a broad inventory of stock packaging supplies to businesses across the region.

The company manufactures custom corrugated boxes, foam inserts, and wood crates on a short-run production line designed for lower startup costs and reduced minimum order quantities. It also stocks more than 15,000 packaging items including boxes, foam, bubble wrap, mailers, tape, labels, and stretch wrap. In-house engineering and design experts follow a proven 7-step design process to create solutions for applications ranging from fighter jet seats to semiconductor equipment, and the company emphasizes eco-friendly material options and material reduction strategies.

CIP serves a diverse industrial base including aerospace and defense, semiconductor, medical, retail, e-commerce, food and beverage, electronics, pharmaceuticals, and general manufacturing. Customers range from startups shipping their first product to companies with in-house packaging engineers.

The company differentiates itself through personalized service, fast lead times—claiming up to three times faster delivery than competitors—and a 30-day upgrade promise for cost-effective packaging. Free consultations and a focus on reducing shipping damage, material cost, and environmental impact round out its value proposition.

name: Colorado Microcircuits
old_description: By automating every step of the IC assembly process we work to increase reliability and drive costs down.
about:
Colorado Microcircuits (CMI) operates a custom-built facility in Loveland, Colorado, specializing in highly automated contract assembly of microwave and RF semiconductors.

CMI assembles single and multi-die components using off-the-shelf or custom packages, including ceramic, air cavity lead frames, overmold lead frames, and high-performance laminates. Its processes cover die attach, wire bonding (short, tuned, and stacked wires), soldering, mixed assembly of ICs and surface-mount components, GGI flip chip, and stacked die. The facility runs industry-standard automated semiconductor assembly equipment and produces volumes ranging from thousands to millions of units per year, with documented ISO 9001 procedures yielding high quality and extremely high yield rates.

The company serves the RF and microwave semiconductor market, acting as a key assembly partner for industry leaders in that sector. Customers include commercial-volume buyers seeking an onshore U.S. partner for competitive pricing and reduced geopolitical supply-chain risk; CMI emphasizes turnkey solutions and short production lead times for clients located within a few hours' drive of its Colorado plant.

CMI differentiates itself through its niche in innovative air cavity packaging and its fully automated, ISO 9001-documented process that extends to each new product. The firm highlights its ability to mitigate supply-chain risk as a high-volume onshore supplier, and its mixed-assembly capability that places surface-mount passives inside air-cavity packages.

name: Colorado Mountain Solar
old_description: At Colorado Mountain Solar, we believe that making the switch to solar should be simple, honest, and rewarding. We strive to empower our customers by providing sustainable, reliable, innovative, and personalized solar energy solutions for energy independence, while supporting the environment and contributing to our community.
about:
Colorado Mountain Solar operates from Buena Vista, Colorado, delivering solar energy solutions to customers across the region. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founder names.

The firm designs and installs both grid-tied and off-grid solar arrays for residential and commercial properties, incorporating battery storage and backup generators where needed. Its services extend to system upgrades, diagnostics and repair, preventive maintenance, performance optimization, priority response, and pre-purchase inspections that produce a detailed Solar System Health Report. Each project begins with an evaluation of energy usage, site conditions, and long-term objectives to tailor the system design.

The customer base spans homeowners and business owners aiming to lower utility costs or gain energy independence, as well as real-estate buyers who need an independent assessment of existing solar installations.

According to the company, its purpose is to make the transition to solar simple, honest, and rewarding, empowering clients with sustainable, reliable, and personalized energy solutions while supporting the environment and the local community.

Colorado Native Electric operates from Indian Hills and Littleton, Colorado, as a family-owned small business founded by Donlin and his wife, both lifelong Colorado residents. Donlin brings over ten years of experience as a licensed electrician to the venture, which they run together as a local service operation.

The company provides custom electrical projects for residential customers, handling tasks that range from simple fixture replacements and rewiring individual rooms to full electrical installations for new home construction. Work also includes addressing inspection-related repairs for home sales. The operation is owner-operated, with Donlin performing the field work and his wife supporting the business.

Primary customers are homeowners in the Front Range area, including those preparing houses for sale who need inspection items resolved, as well as individuals building or remodeling custom homes. Testimonials cite room rewires, inspection-driven repairs, and general electrical upgrades as typical engagements.

Donlin states the business was started to deliver detailed, high-quality electrical work with an emphasis on safety and competitive pricing, leveraging his familiarity with the region and his trade experience to serve neighbors directly.
